results.name: Niva Arta
results.description:
The Niva Arta is based on the classic three-door Lada Niva SUV. Its doors were removed, ground clearance was increased, the suspension was reinforced, the wheel arches were cut off, and the rear was transformed into something resembling a pickup truck. The cargo bed can accommodate an anti-tank missile turret or other weapons.

The model was made by my friend ZZimbaba, the textures were created by me (Roif).

Credits - t.me/RoifsWorkshop

«Нива Арта» создана на базе классической трехдверной Lada Niva Пикап. Ее лишили дверей, увеличили дорожный просвет, усилили подвеску, срезали колесные арки, а заднюю часть превратили в подобие пикапа. На грузовой платформе можно разместить турель для противотанкового комплекса или иное вооружение.

results.name: Zastava M70 Pistol
results.description:
An extremely low-poly model of a Yugoslav pistol, chambered in .32 ACP apparently for use with the Milicija police and not to be confused with the M70 rifle. It was modeled specifically for the [We Were Brothers](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3486576445) modpack for Easy Red 2, meaning it is already optimized for usage in games. The texture is from an image I pulled online.

It is completely free to use and modify for any purposes, no need to credit me.

results.name: Metal Bunk Bed
results.description:
This is a realistic metal bunk bed designed for use in games, architectural visualization, and interior design projects. The model features a sturdy metal frame with a simple yet functional design, making it suitable for various environments such as military barracks, dormitories, prisons, or survival-themed games.

Features:-High-quality textures for a realistic look-Optimized polygon count for efficient performance in real-time engines-Fabric mattress and pillows with detailed material work-PBR-ready materials for accurate lighting and shading-Compatible with Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine, and morePerfect for realistic and low-poly scenes, game environments, or animation projects.
